newsitem.title: LIECHTENSTEIN: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR LIECHTENSTEIN V LITHUANIA WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR LIECHTENSTEIN V LITHUANIA WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Teams for World Cup group eight qualifier between Liechtenstein and Lithuania on Wednesday:

Liechtenstein - 1-Martin Heeb, 2-Juergen Ospelt, 3-Patrick Hefti, 4-Thomas Hanselmann, 5-Martin Stocklasa, 6-Daniel Hasler, 7-Daniel Telser, 8-Christoph Frick, 9-Franz Schaedler, 10-Peter Klaunzer, 11-Daniel Frick

Lithuania - 1-Gintaras Stauce, 2-Tomas Ziukas, 3-Andreius Tereskinas, 4-Arunas Suika, 5-Raimondas Vainoras, 6-Raimondas Zutautas, 7-Darius Maciulevicius, 8-Valdas Ivanauskas, 9- Irmantas Stumbrys, 10-Edgaras Jankauskas, 11-Aurelijus Skarbalius
